patch.value: Compose a compact prerequisite brief for one intended native action

Combine SDK command contracts, item readiness and declared evidence for an explicitly selected native command and item. Compose authoritative core facts without duplicating validators or selecting work.

One call identifies missing close fields and unresolved prerequisites; Satisfied fields are references without repeated bodies; Read-only previews perform zero mutations and carry typed unsupported-capability refusals with remedies; Typed SDK and CLI emit bounded TOON/JSON; docs, non-git public-data validation and npm/Bun release evidence are recorded

value.text: Class audit completed across all runtime sources, SDK entry points, native registration/rendering and installed consumers. Rule 1: composed actions must account for every constituent command and distinguish invocation-option presence from persisted fields; start now uses resolveTypeDefinition, resolveCommandOptionPolicyState and commandOptionFlagLabel for required/disabled/hidden/error states, while close does not inherit update policies. Arbitrary required start flags are explicit missing entries plus unsupported refusals/remedies because the request does not accept those mutation options. Rule 2: ownership admission requires a current nonblank assignee; residual principals after native close/reopen no longer block either start or strict close, while legacy assignee-only claims still deny other actors. Rule 3: dispatch selection roles and nonterminal classifications are not explicit action admission; human/gate/container/blocked/draft classifications no longer veto selected starts, and native terminal/relationship checks remain. Other assignee uses are display/filter/history paths in index.ts and disclosure.ts, not competing admission implementations. All consumers share action.ts; JSON/TOON native non-git and all seven packed npm/Bun scenarios now exercise these classes. The existing classification test still verifies SDK container/human/gate/blocked facts and now also verifies successful native execution, so coverage was strengthened rather than removed.
